sentences.text: Taikoa Oy is a cohort company registered on 2023-07-28 under the industry code 70200, management consultancy activities.
Business Finland shows a funding decision for 2026 of EUR 60 000; the export gives the year only.
The register also holds a start-up notification dated 2023-08-10 and a board change dated 2025-11-20.
Technology and business readiness both read level 4 and investment readiness reads level 3 on the radar's rules, based on that funding.
The registered industry is consultancy and no ocean category is found in the record, so impact is unknown.
For the fund this stays on the watchlist.
